file_insights.purpose: Swift Package Manager manifest for minimal iOS test project
file_insights.significance: Defines package structure, platform requirements, and test targets

patterns_discovered.name: Swift Package Manager for iOS
patterns_discovered.description: Using SPM manifest approach rather than Xcode project for iOS minimal setup

patterns_discovered.name: Minimal test project scaffold
patterns_discovered.description: No external dependencies, empty targets ready for population
patterns_discovered.benefit: Lightweight foundation for validating bootstrap flow without bloat

patterns_discovered.name: Library-based structure
patterns_discovered.description: Exporting targets as a reusable library rather than app
patterns_discovered.benefit: Enables testing of shareable component patterns

patterns_discovered.name: Paired test target
patterns_discovered.description: Test target explicitly depends on main target
patterns_discovered.benefit: Establishes convention for test isolation and structure

gotchas_discovered.issue: iOS projects typically use Xcode projects (.xcodeproj), not pure SPM
gotchas_discovered.context: SPM for iOS is less conventional than for macOS or server targets
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Document decision rationale; verify SwiftUI/UIKit compatibility if needed

gotchas_discovered.issue: No actual SwiftUI code present despite project name mentioning SwiftUI
gotchas_discovered.context: Package.swift references SwiftUI but targets are empty stubs
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Add example SwiftUI views to populate the library target

gotchas_discovered.issue: Test target exists but contains no actual test implementations
gotchas_discovered.context: No .swift test files or assertions to validate bootstrap flow
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Add at least one sample test to confirm test target is buildable

discoveries.approach_outcome: SUCCESS - Created valid minimal iOS test project scaffold with Swift Package Manager manifest. Established directory structure, package configuration with iOS 17 minimum platform, and paired library/test targets. Project is syntactically correct but lacks concrete implementation content.
